_fact_source: 'sources' (default): find real facts on Wikipedia/web, then rewrite them. 'llm': skip retrieval and ask the model for facts from its own knowledge - simpler and often better for famous places, but nothing is verified, so it can invent.
_llm_options: The three llm_* fields above are set for OpenRouter (recommended for adult-aligned facts). Other providers: Groq -> key 'gsk_...', base 'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1', model 'openai/gpt-oss-120b'. Local Ollama -> key '' (empty), base 'http://localhost:11434/v1', model 'llama3.1:8b'. Other OpenRouter models: 'sao10k/l3.3-euryale-70b' (edgiest), 'cognitivecomputations/dolphin-mistral-24b-venice-edition' (uncensored), 'mistralai/mistral-nemo' (cheapest).
